notes.title: Update 1.1 - Boom Royale: More Smoothness and Captivating Voices!
notes.content:
We're excited to introduce the latest update to Boom Royale, version 1.1! In this update, we are dedicated to improving the gaming experience, making it even more immersive and exciting. Here are the highlights:

1. **Enhanced Graphics:**
    - We have readjusted the graphics to provide an even more pleasant visual experience. Details have been refined to bring the world of Boom Royale to life in a vibrant and captivating way.

2. **Improved Performance:**
    - We have removed obstacles that affected game performance. Now, Boom Royale offers smoother gameplay, ensuring that every movement and action occurs with precision, providing a more fluid FPS experience.

3. **Captivating Voices:**
    - To add an extra dose of fun and excitement, we have introduced animated voices for the characters. Now, every action is accompanied by animated commentary, making the game's atmosphere more vivid and immersive.

4. **Optimized Map:**
    - We listened to community feedback and retuned one of our maps to optimize performance, resulting in a significant improvement in frames per second (FPS). The fun is now more intense than ever!

We're committed to delivering the best gaming experience possible, and this update is just the beginning. We thank all Boom Royale players for their continued support, and we hope you enjoy every second of this exciting new version. Get ready to dive into Boom Royale 1.1 - the fun is now even more explosive!

notes.title: Boom Royale Seasons 1
notes.content:
Boom Royale is a game that is constantly evolving to offer players an even more exciting and immersive experience. Our latest update brought significant changes that are sure to get you excited.

First, we've completely overhauled the game's lobby. The lobby is now more interactive and aesthetically appealing, providing a more engaging entry experience. Additionally, we've added the ability to customize your character's look right in the lobby, so you can show off your unique style before you even enter battle.

Another important change is the reduction in the number of players per room, from 5 to 4. This decision was made with the aim of creating a more dynamic and strategic gaming experience, in addition to reducing latency and improving gameplay, providing even more combat. intense.

The game's soundtrack has also been enhanced with exciting new sounds for the maps and lobby. Now you can completely immerse yourself in the game environment, feeling every explosion and action as if you were inside the world of Boom Royale.

And speaking of maps, we present a series of new maps with a forest theme in pixel art. Each of them offers unique challenges and stunning settings, allowing you to explore the mysterious and dangerous corners of the forest while facing your opponents.

Our menus have been completely redesigned to make navigation more intuitive and enjoyable. Now, you will be able to easily access all the game's features and customize your character with ease.

Additionally, the lobby now offers an improved socialization experience, allowing players to interact with each other before jumping into battle. You can show off your new skins, exchange tips and strategies with your friends, and even challenge other players to a friendly match.

Boom Royale is always looking for ways to surprise and delight its players, and our team is looking forward to bringing you even more exciting new features in the future. Get ready for a blast of fun and adventure in our ever-evolving world!

notes.title: party royale
notes.content:
Welcome to the new and improved [b]Boom Royale![/b] With new mini games and the exciting soundtrack, you will be immersed in an epic gaming experience. Fixes to jump animations and graphics, along with server stability improvements, ensure that you experience smooth, stutter-free gameplay.

By updating the allowed amount of players in normal battles to 5, you will get even more adrenaline in each match. And with reduced wait times to find players, you can jump into battle in a snap.

The game's impressive features, such as the leaderboard, item pickups and power-ups, interactive world elements, and character customization with unique outfits, ensure an exciting and personalized experience.

Furthermore, the update reduced the load on the GPU, ensuring a smooth experience even on older devices. With these improvements and updates, Boom Royale is the best multiplayer shooter you'll ever play! Team up with other players from all over the world and show off your combat skills in this epic arena.
